gloss.RP-DETERMINISTIC: the state at one time fixes the state at every other time
gloss.RP-INFORMATION-CONSERVING: the flow preserves the total phase-space volume (global Liouville)
gloss.RP-LINEAR-CARRIER: SCOPE RESTRICTION, not a physical postulate: the vector field is linear, so the flow is exp(tA)
gloss.RP-MARGINAL-INFORMATION-CONSERVING: each degree of freedom independently preserves its own 2-dimensional phase-space area
gloss.RP-REVERSIBLE: the evolution map is invertible; distinct states stay distinct

assumption_tags.namespace_note: RP-* names physical postulates and is disjoint from the programme's computational-regime tags.

claim_boundary: This establishes the three dimensions and the two codimensions as closed forms in n on the linear carrier, with each derivation step re-checked concretely for n = 1..7 and the codimension identities proved as polynomial identities rather than sampled. It closes the GENERAL_N_NOT_ESTABLISHED gate.

derivation_steps.step_2_two_characterisations: A in sp <=> Omega A symmetric <=> Omega A + A^T Omega = 0
derivation_steps.step_3_bijection: S -> Omega S is a linear bijection Sym(2n) -> sp(2n), with explicit inverse A -> -Omega A
derivation_steps.step_4_symmetric_dimension: dim Sym(2n) = n(2n + 1), counted over the symmetric basis
derivation_steps.step_5_marginal_independence: the n marginal functionals have pairwise disjoint support, hence are independent
derivation_steps.step_6_liouville: the trace functional is nonzero, hence has rank 1
derivation_steps.step_7_polynomial_identities: the two codimension identities hold as polynomials in n

does_not_establish: a formally verified induction; the steps are machine-checked and the identities are proved, but the assembly of the steps into a derivation is human-authored and unverified by a proof assistant
anything about nonlinear carriers, where the dimension count has no direct analogue
anything about infinite-dimensional or field-theoretic state spaces
an equivalence in the reverse-mathematics sense; there is still no reversal over a base theory
a reproduction, confirmation or refutation of Carcassi--Aidala's own derivation
any quantum, causal, or field-theoretic claim
next_gate: REVERSE_PHYSICS_HAMILTONIAN_PRIVILEGE_TORUS_G1: whether any of this survives on a carrier that is a manifold rather than a vector space.

polynomial_identity_argument.argument: Both sides of each identity are polynomials in n of degree at most 2; agreement at 4 > 2 + 1 distinct points forces equality as polynomials.

provenance.independence_argument: Rail A derives the closed forms structurally (an explicit bijection onto Sym(2n), a support argument for functional independence, and polynomial identities). Rail B never uses the structural argument at all: it builds the defining constraint systems for each n and computes brute-force exact ranks, then compares. A structural slip and an elimination slip would have to coincide to survive.

supersedes.in_what_respect: the n-dependence only; the G0 witnesses, the finite-flow strengthening and the inter-DOF localisation of the obstruction are not restated here and remain the G0 certificate's content

theorem.growth: the insufficiency gap grows quadratically in n, so the assumption becomes less adequate, not more, as the system gets larger
theorem.necessity_unchanged: sp <= marginal <= sl holds for every n, so marginal information conservation remains necessary throughout
theorem.separation_threshold: codim(sp in marginal) = 2n(n - 1) vanishes exactly at n in {0, 1} and is strictly positive for every n >= 2. Marginal information conservation is therefore insufficient at EVERY number of degrees of freedom above one, and the n = 2 datum of the G0 certificate was not an accident of the smallest case.
